children.text: Dear Tom, I am glad to get your letter and tell you about my life.
children.cn: 亲爱的汤姆，很高兴收到你的来信并向你介绍我的生活。
children.notes: be glad to do sth.: 很高兴做某事
children.statement: 作者写信是为了告诉Tom关于自己的生活。
children.explanation: 信中“tell you about my life”表明了写信的目的。

children.text: I live in a quiet community apartment building with friendly neighbours.
children.cn: 我住在社区公寓楼里，邻居们都很友善。
children.notes: apartment building: 公寓楼; friendly neighbours: 友善的邻居
children.statement: 作者居住的社区环境非常嘈杂。
children.explanation: 句子中明确说明社区是“quiet”（安静的）。
children.keywords: live in, quiet, apartment, friendly, neighbours

children.text: There is a supermarket and a hospital near my community.
children.cn: 我的社区附近有一家超市和一家医院。
children.notes: near: 在……附近; hospital: 医院
children.statement: 句中用了“there is”是因为后接单数名词“a supermarket”。
children.explanation: there be 句型遵循就近原则，后面的近端名词 a supermarket 为单数，故用 is。

children.text: My school is close to my home, about two kilometres away.
children.cn: 我的学校离我家很近，大约有两公里远。
children.notes: be close to: 离……近; kilometres: 公里
children.statement: 作者的学校距离家非常遥远。
children.explanation: 句子描述学校“is close to my home”（离家近）。
children.keywords: close to, home, two kilometres, away

children.text: I take the bus to school at 7:00 a.m. every morning.
children.cn: 我每天早上7点坐公交车去上学。
children.notes: take the bus: 坐公交车
children.statement: 作者每天骑自行车去学校。
children.explanation: 句子中说的是“take the bus”（坐公交车）。
children.keywords: take the bus, school, 7:00 a.m., morning

children.text: Classes begin at 8:00 a.m., and we have seven lessons a day.
children.cn: 早上8点开始上课，我们一天有七节课。
children.statement: 作者学校每天一共有七节课。
children.explanation: 句子中明确指出了“seven lessons a day”。

children.text: We study Chinese, Maths, and English, and my favourite subject is English.
children.cn: 我们学习语文、数学和英语，我最喜欢的科目是英语。
children.notes: favourite subject: 最喜欢的科目
children.statement: 作者最喜欢的科目是数学。
children.explanation: 句子中明确说明“my favourite subject is English”。

children.text: In my free time, I often play basketball with my friends.
children.cn: 在空闲时间，我经常和朋友们一起打篮球。
children.notes: free time: 空闲时间; play basketball: 打篮球
children.statement: “in my free time” 表示“在我的空闲时间”。
children.explanation: free time 即指业余/空闲时间。

children.text: Dear Tom, I am extremely glad to receive your letter and share details about my daily life with you.
children.cn: 亲爱的汤姆，收到你的来信并与你分享我日常生活的细节，我感到无比高兴。
children.notes: extremely: 极度地; share... with...: 与……分享……
children.statement: 句子中的“extremely”用来修饰形容词“glad”。
children.explanation: 副词 extremely 意为“极其；非常”，在此修饰形容词 glad。
children.keywords: glad, receive, letter, share, daily life

children.text: Currently, I live in a modern community apartment building where people are quiet, kind, and always ready to help each other.
children.cn: 目前，我住在一段现代化的社区公寓楼里，那里的居民安静、善良，并且随时准备互相帮助。
children.notes: currently: 目前; help each other: 互相帮助
children.statement: “where” 在句中引导定语从句修饰 community apartment building。
children.explanation: where 引导关系副词定语从句，在从句中作地点状语。
children.keywords: currently, live in, modern, apartment, help each other

children.text: Moreover, essential facilities like a supermarket and a hospital are nearby, and my school is only about two kilometres away.
children.cn: 此外，超市和医院等必要设施就在附近，我的学校距离这里也只有大约两公里。
children.notes: essential facilities: 基础/必要设施; nearby: 在附近
children.statement: “Moreover” 是连接副词，表示递进关系“此外”。
children.explanation: Moreover 用作副词表示补充和递进说明。
children.keywords: Moreover, essential facilities, supermarket, hospital, nearby

children.text: Every morning at 7:00, I take the bus to school so that I can arrive well before classes start at 8:00.
children.cn: 每天早上7点我坐公交车去学校，以便能在8点上课前从容到达。
children.notes: so that: 以便/为了; arrive: 到达
children.statement: “so that” 引导目的状语从句。
children.explanation: so that 在句中表示目的，意为“以便；为了”。
children.keywords: take the bus, so that, arrive, classes start

children.text: Although we have seven lessons a day covering subjects such as Chinese and Maths, English remains my absolute favourite.
children.cn: 尽管我们一天有七节课，涵盖了语文和数学等科目，但英语依然是我最喜欢的学科。
children.notes: although: 尽管; cover: 涵盖; remain: 依然是
children.statement: 句子中的“Although”引导让步状语从句。
children.explanation: although 是从属连词，引导让步状语从句，意为“虽然；尽管”。
children.keywords: Although, seven lessons, subjects, English, favourite

children.text: In addition, I enjoy playing basketball with my classmates after school because it keeps me energetic and healthy.
children.cn: 此外，放学后我喜欢和同学们一起打篮球，因为这能让我保持精力充沛和健康。
children.notes: in addition: 此外; energetic: 精力充沛的; healthy: 健康的
children.statement: 作者打篮球是因为它能让人保持精力和健康。
children.explanation: because 后的原因从句明确提到“it keeps me energetic and healthy”。
children.keywords: In addition, enjoy playing basketball, energetic, healthy
